replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design confirms a password login precedes biometric enrolment; credential stuffing attack on that endpoint is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design explicitly stores refresh token in plain app storage; disclosure path is design-created."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design states biometrics only unlock the screen; local-only check bypass is a concrete distinct attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack (read token from plain storage) and harm (account takeover) as T2.","duplicateOf":"T2"},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design's non-server-verified biometric and non-device-bound token support the attribution/revocation gap."}]}
